requirements.description: Future-year earnings availability used as a sample inclusion rule.

routes.mapping_notes: The sample requires nonmissing next-year earnings but does not identify the earnings item or its exact definition; IB is a candidate field, not a confirmed mapping.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Local delisting fields are present, but coverage and the paper-specific adjustment treatment are unconfirmed.

Within-fyear 0–1 decile rank of (ΔACT−ΔCHE)/average total assets; ACT and CHE are Compustat current assets and cash, with t−1 needed for the change and denominator.
Within-fyear 0–1 rank of −[ΔLCT−ΔDLC−ΔTXP]/average total assets; source excludes current debt and taxes payable from the liability change.
Within-fyear 0–1 rank of −D&A (DP)/average total assets.

implementation_issues.description: The paper reports regressions but does not name the estimator for either the pooled fit or the separate annual fits. The estimator affects coefficients and inference.

The paper used the 1998 Compustat and 1999 CRSP editions; this assessment routes to current local snapshots as required, so sample/field vintage differences may remain.

COMP.FUNDA catalog metadata: Catalog has annual GVKEY/date/fiscal-year fields and labels for total/current assets, cash, debt, taxes payable, D&A, receivables, payables, inventory and income before extraordinary items.
CRSP.MSF catalog metadata: Monthly stock returns product with PERMNO, DATE, RET/RETX, PRC and SHROUT.
CRSP.MSEDELIST catalog metadata: Monthly delisting event product with PERMNO, delisting date and DLRET.
CRSP.DSENAMES catalog metadata: Historical daily name/exchange product with effective name dates, PERMNO, EXCHCD and SHRCD.
CRSP.MSIX catalog metadata: Monthly capitalization decile index with calendar dates and decile return fields; catalog product label identifies NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ universe.
CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE catalog metadata: Effective GVKEY–PERMNO link history with validity dates and link type/primary flags.
Shared exact preferred COMP.FUNDA probe confirms candidate accounting fields are present.
Shared exact preferred CRSP.MSF probe confirms monthly return, PERMNO, date, price and shares fields.
Shared exact preferred CRSP.MSEDELIST probe confirms PERMNO, date and delisting-return fields.
Shared exact preferred CRSP.DSENAMES probe confirms historical exchange-code and effective-name-date fields.
Shared exact preferred CRSP.MSIX probe confirms monthly decile return fields are present; it does not confirm an NYSE/AMEX-only breakpoint universe.
Shared exact preferred CCMXPF link-table probe confirms GVKEY/PERMNO and effective link-date fields.

review_notes: Current local data vintages are the only routes assessed; the paper used historical 1998/1999 editions.
